source.selection: All 5 drug conditions × 3 author-supplied outcome categories × 3 biological replicates; no donor/Cas9 and NTC controls excluded explicitly. Outcome categories are retained verbatim and are not assumed to sum to 100%.

reading_question: Compare treatments within each of three author-supplied repair outcomes, using individual narrow bar panels. A global-scale grouped plot is an optional alternative when comparing absolute outcome magnitudes.
transfer: 4 treatments × 2 outcomes × 3 biological replicates, reversed CSV row order. The same category colors, means, SD and raw values must remain faithful.
candidate_decisions: Three independent 60 × 62 mm bar panels, each with slender outline bars and all 15 biological repeats
Identical data-region margins, treatment order, font and stroke settings across panels
Explicit outcome-specific original-percent ranges, no hidden normalization and no comparison of absolute heights across differently scaled panels
Bright blue/jade/coral identify outcomes; a short defined treatment alias keeps each narrow panel readable
Unscaled side-by-side PDF/SVG preview preserves independent vector panels and 8 pt text
Grouped alternative retains a global 0–55% scale with positive measured stroke clearance between its hollow bars
limits: Descriptive comparison only; no cross-condition pairing inferred, significance marks added, or new causal biological conclusion.
This has more measured outcomes than the single-HDR basic example. It is a different reading task, not a matched before/after aesthetic experiment.
Separate outcome ranges change the reading task from between-outcome absolute amounts to within-outcome treatment comparisons; both variants are labeled and retained.
